turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Sure! Let me show you one example step by step.
"My sister has ___ idea." The word "idea" starts with the sound "i", which is a vowel sound. So: My sister has an idea.
The rule: we use an before a vowel sound and a before other sounds.
Right: My sister has a cat. Wrong: My sister has an cat.

Your turn. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag.
(answer with only the missing word)
